justification.rationale: Use the pinned precomputed mangrove restoration model as one composite T4 component for historically lost mangrove systems. The user selected the Mapping Ocean Wealth approach; exact release, scientific interpretation and activation remain pending. Current mangrove T4 is empty at evidence e47fc255700f96afa5a6b13d1dcaa08c92c0cb90.
justification.mechanism: The source model combines loss drivers, tidal amplitude, antecedent and future sea-level rise, hydrological disturbance, patch size/count, connectivity and loss timing into relative restoration ease. Source estimated restorable area combines corrected gross historical loss and eligible loss-driver proportions. A locally feasible restoration intervention is not established by these attributes alone.
justification.source_relationship: Preserve native OVERALL_SCORE in [0,1] when Restorable_km2>0. Source code scores positive-area units and fills missing export scores with zero. All348 zero-area units match zero-score units in3983 units. Source eligibility excludes erosion and settlement; historic commodity conversion does not establish present land availability. Min_Score/Max_Score describe parameter sensitivity, not success confidence.
justification.analyst_choices: Select archived Worthington2024v1, not moving MOW/GMW values. Identity score; no observed-range stretching, percent conversion or inferred weight. Keep whole/partial-unit area accounting separate from score. Preserve independent gates; do not score source composite components again. The area validity ceiling is a physical input-QA bound, not an ecological threshold.
justification.transfer_limits: Only mangrove_restoration__tidal_coastal and its named subpractices. No transfer to coastal wetlands or forest restoration. Irregular typological polygons are native score support, not restoration footprints. Boundary-only touches must be removed by spatial overlay. Missing geometry remains unknown; invalid geometry blocks use. Future sea-level scenario/horizon and associated publication/supplement provenance remain unresolved.
justification.binding: Worthington et al.2024 Zenodo11283186 v1,2024-05-24,CC-BY-4.0. Geometry SHA256 6730889b731dbfeb7a86e18741324e32fccee761cdf42dd043362c22d4b7232d; Data Exports.zip SHA256 8e2ad5c579eedc3d4fef84f36536fd09bd59b208cf91a26d179a8cba7c114596. Join score.Type to area.Type one-to-one, area.ID to geometry.ID one-to-one with Type cross-check. Auxiliary1km ID is a distinct grid key. EPSG:4326 vector grain, no invented raster resolution. Full table/geometry archives verified; selected code members only. No verified equivalent hosted release or live-service fallback. Exact member locators and hashes in source-notes/mangrove-2024-v1.json.
justification.area_accounting: Whole-unit model estimate:100*Restorable_km2 hectares, counted once. Partial unit without verified loss allocation: estimate unknown, lower0, upper source estimated hectares. Union AOIs, check inter-unit topology and deduplicate release/unit IDs before aggregation. Unknown coverage prevents complete finite AOI bounds. Never use polygon area, polygon fractions, score-weighted hectares or beneficiary-buffer area. Optional release-matched loss allocation remains future work; not enabled by this profile.
justification.replacement_policy: No current mangrove T4 rows at checked revision; do not delete variable names by pattern. Future overlaps need exact row identity and semantic review. Retain independently reviewed legal, host and physical gates. Hydroperiod is not tidal amplitude. No pattern-based removal of salinity, elevation, temperature or hydrology. Source components enter only through the composite to avoid double weighting.
justification.approval_remaining: Ratify dataset/code acquisition adapter and formal source admission; no new SRC or EV created here.; Review and approve proposed VONT/T1/BIND definitions, absent from checked canonical evidence configuration.; Resolve future sea-level-rise scenario and horizon embedded in the source model.; Resolve associated publication/supplement provenance; 2018 report is not interchangeable with this 2024 release.; Approve geometry repair plus antimeridian, inter-unit topology and pilot overlay checks.; Validate any eligible loss footprint or optional within-unit allocation before pixel-area/intersection claims.; Explicit human scientific acceptance required; profile execution tests are not approval.
